payload.name: acceptance_criteria
payload.value:
- When a verification tool cannot start, the operator receives its actionable error and an executable recovery handoff, and that operational failure does not consume source-code rework.
- When verification inputs are equivalent, admissible passing evidence is reused; changed or unavailable inputs revoke reuse, and failed checks still block.
- When the repaired commands run as a consumer, required fresh checks remain enabled and actual reuse or miss reasons and elapsed time are visible.

payload.text: Observer repair: launch-failure regressions failed before the fix in candidate and destination paths. The repaired focused selection passes; a launched exit 126 remains a check failure. Early engine preflight now precedes candidate checks and prints a uv command that supplies candidate environment and destination cwd. Existing cache/input controls passed 135 tests. Packaged-consumer validation initially failed because its fixture omitted the existing locked markdownlint prerequisite; fixture now installs those same locked packages offline. No dependency versions or verification gates changed.

Observer consumer results: baseline-wheel to candidate-wheel upgrade and verification controls passed. Thirty warm runs reused all three Pyright platform checks, while the unscoped check executed thirty times. Fresh runs were 2.699s and 2.741s; warm median 1.603s; cold cache 4.031s on a 10,000-line fixture. Source errors, forced-fresh mode, malformed cache and a real TZ environment change all forced fresh checks as required. These are existing compiler-cache measurements, not evidence of an end-to-end redesign speedup. Installed-wheel CLI checks also preserved missing-tool and Permission denied errors with infrastructure_error=true and nonzero exit. Actual uv handoff probe selected candidate venv and candidate Ruff with destination cwd. The 200-test final affected group and 135 cache/input tests passed; full verification now running on the finished source.

Remaining measurement boundary: this observer patch fixes the demonstrated launch-only operational failures and early self-host preflight. It does not claim to eliminate all candidate/destination/pre-push pytest repetition. A current source-inventory comparison found 875 extra Python/config source entries under main ignored evidence directories; the broad recipe intentionally includes potential import sources, so merely deleting that input coverage would be unsafe. Separate worktree pytest runtimes also have genuinely different launcher, paths, runtime and environment identities. Keep this task open until remaining reuse and integrated overhead are evaluated with the baseline and final redesign.

Full verification diagnostic: pytest faulthandler emitted a 60-second stack snapshot while an integration scenario was inside pytest_inputs._dependency via _landing_python -> landing_fingerprint -> destination_inputs -> record_verification. This is a live stack sample, not a test failure or a proven timing attribution. Investigate repeated dependency-tree hashing (including repeated root.resolve per file) with a pinned before/after microbenchmark and symlink/change controls before changing its trust recipe.

Follow-up probe (no engine edit): on an isolated 2,000-file tree, resolving the dependency root once per hash instead of per file gave median 0.071s versus 0.089s across three interleaved samples. Both returned the same digest, invalidated a content mutation and refused an external symlink. This small primitive delta does not establish the cause or cure of the integration-test latency; the full-suite stacks also include the test ledger audit hook. Preserve that distinction when measuring the remaining hashing cost.

Observer repair candidate completed required full verification: run c0b2994dffce485d852915b381947ba0, all 42 configured checks passed in 687.822s; ordinary pytest 7841 passed, 3 skipped, 1 xfailed; live-ledger pytest 187 passed. Compiler/platform/projection/security/comment/ledger gates all green. No loop drove this work. Integrating via ordinary Git with normal hooks; the existing destination-unverified marker stays until a fresh destination proof is recorded. This task stays open for remaining measured overhead work.

Observer finding: the kit and work-tracker skill document assigning a record before planning, but the engine tracker write seam rejects assign with a mirror._MIRRORED_WRITES translation error. No reservation was recorded by the refused command. Reconcile the published owner/reservation interface across engine, standalone kit and HTTP API; preserve correct writer attribution and readiness gates. This was found while preparing baseline .2, not implemented during the verification repair.
